answer: Burned entry fees stop cheap sybils. Every new alias pays 40 POA that is destroyed on registration, so spawning 100 fake identities costs 4,000 POA before any of them earns a cent. An alias earns its opal trust badge only after 3 verified jobs, and its past work leaves an echo in a public record peers can read. Each epoch, peers re-check 1 in 5 completed jobs; a faked result burns the badge, forfeits pending pay, and bars the alias for 14 epochs. A comet alias that flashes in, grabs one payout, and vanishes still loses its fee and leaves a trail, so mass sybil farming never pays.
